name: Aizawa Yukari
source:
A famous model who appears in numerous TV commercials—and Iori’s classmate.
She always looks beautiful no matter what she does, giving off a more mature vibe compared to her classmates. However, in reality, she is an eccentric girl who only acts according to her own desires.

She has a playful and somewhat teasing side, which creates a stark contrast between her image as a model and her true personality. She frequently skips school for her job, but deep down, longs to live a normal student life.

One of her most distinctive traits is her (almost) complete lack of self-sufficiency, and she often uses her job as an excuse to avoid bothersome tasks.
